title: Cebu Province mulls school protocols amid rising heat

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro is drafting a local executive order (EO) on school protocols amid rising temperatures and the looming threat of El Niño, which could affect classroom conditions. Details of the provincial measure remain under development as the government consolidates existing policies, coordinates with relevant agencies, and plans for local implementation. “We are still fine-tuning my EO, and then we will come up with it as soon as we have it finished,” she said in a press briefing on Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026.
